en.text:
"...Now, that deathly Ai-no-Yama song was being heard in a deathly mood, and not only by the party of five guests and the troupe around them. One more person was there, listening."

"Jutting out beyond the courtyard was a half-story room, and unlike the room after room of brightness all around it, this one was strangely gloomy and dim. No wonder. Here were kept women tormented by illness, and women gone mad for their secret lovers,"

"and since the place served as rest-cure and lock-up both, it was the kind of room whose rumors never took a single day off: that some woman had coughed blood and died here, that a ghost appeared."

"Before the ballad began, a woman in this room had ground her ink till it flowed, unrolled a roll of paper already quite long, and was composing a letter."

"The courtesans of Furuichi did not go in for flashy things like the Katsuyama hairdo and the shikake. They kept to a plain, ordinary-woman style, and on some women that look worked remarkably well,"

"so stories were not rare of a younger man staking his very life in love for a mature woman in a white waist-wrap."

"The woman now writing the letter was likewise suffering from illness, but her plain style showed her character so well that no one could have taken her for what she was."

〝……この死ぬような間の山節を、死ぬような心地で
聞いていたものが、五人づれの客と、それを取巻くこ
この一座のほかに、まだ一人はあったのであります。〟

〝中庭から向うへ張り出した中二階の一間が、<ruby>間毎<rt>まごと</rt></ruby>間
毎の明るいのと違って、いやに陰気で薄暗い。それも
そのはず、こには病気に悩む女、間夫狂いをする女、〟

〝それらを保養と監禁と両方の意味に使用されるとこ
ろですから、ここで血を吐いて死んだ女があるとか、
幽霊が出るとか、そんな噂のしょっちゅう絶えたこと
のない一間であります。〟

〝間の山節が始まる前に、この一間で墨をすり流して、
巻紙をもうかなり長く使って、文を<ruby>認<rt>したた</rt></ruby>めていた女。〟

〝古市の遊女は、勝山髷に<ruby>裲襠<rt>しかけ</rt></ruby>というような派手なこ
とをしなかった、素人風の地味な扮装でいたから、女
によっては、それのうつりが非常によく、〟

〝白ゆもじの年増に、年下の男が命を打込むまでに恋
をしたというような話も往々あることでした。〟

〝ここにいま文を書いている女も、病に悩む女であり
ましたが、素人風がこうしているとまでに取れないほ
ど、それほど女の人柄をよく見せるのでありました。〟

en.text:
"Beneath a vermilion square lantern her brush ran, then held back, and from time to time she wept. And then came the earlier verse—"

　　　　　　"The bells at dusk and dawn
　　　　　　　Cry, 'jakumetsu iraku,'
　　　　　　　Yet none who hear are startled."

"Her half-written brush slipped from her fingers. She held perfectly still, listening, as Otama's instrumental interlude went streaming and scattering in patterns, like woven silk."

　　　　　　"Though flowers scatter, spring will bloom.
　　　　　　　Though birds go home to their old nests,
　　　　　　　The road to death, once gone, has no way back."

Kanae"Aaah."
Sayo"And the injury to your leg, Miss?"
Kanae"I cannot move it for now, but it is fine. Bones and tendons are not damaged."
Sayo"That is a relief... With your permission."
Kanae"...Nanny? The dressing can wait till later."
Kanae"It is not finished yet, anyway."
Sayo"No. We appear to have reached the final curtain. The cavalry has been taking its time very thoroughly, but at last it has favored us with an appearance."
Kanae"Oh, such a pity. Saari mehnat hum karein, and they take the best part?"
Sayo"That, too, is the sweetheart's allotted part. Ours, for now, is to withdraw."
Sayo"There may yet be an extra round. Regrettably, if we are caught up in it in our present condition, we will only be a hindrance."
Kanae"That would be very heroine-like too, in its way. Yes, you are right. Let us leave the rest to the knight, shall we?"
Sayo"Ji. To the knight..."
Kanae"..."
Sayo"..."
Kanae"You heard it, no?"
Sayo"At that distance, fragments only. The essential points, however, arrived quite clearly."
Sayo"Slipping a terminal into place, in case something like this should happen, was the correct decision. Sorimachi must be thanked."
Kanae"Yes. Thanks to it, a good deal has become visible..."
Kanae"Why he ended up dead. Is it not so, Nanny?"
Sayo"...Ji."

en.html:
Then she looked up.
At the enemy who would surely kill her with the next shot.

And indeed—
The muzzle fixed its aim, full of the will to pour out every drop of frustration that an insignificant little enemy had made it store up.

So this was as far as she could go.
Ichijou thought so.

No regrets.
Frustration, yes—she wished she could have fought more.

Beside that person.
But that wish, at least, had been granted once.

Compared with living out a long life tormented by her own failure to accomplish anything, this moment, ending after a short fight, was beyond doubt a happy one.
So Ichijou Ayane thought.

She accepted death—
And clenched her fist.

To fight to the very last.

[text0160b]
　そして見上げる。
　次こそは己を殺すであろう敵を。

　まさしく――
　物の数ならぬ小敵に溜め込まされた憤懣を、すべて
ぶち撒ける意思に満ちて、砲口が狙点を定める。

　ここまでか。
　一条は思った。

　悔いはない。
　悔しさはある――願わくばもっと戦いたかった。

　<ruby>あの人<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>と共に。
　しかしその願いは、一度だけだが叶えられたのだ。

　何も為し得ない己に悶々として長い生涯を過ごすの
に比べ、短い闘争の末に果てるこの今は、間違いなく
幸福に違いないと。
　綾弥一条はそう思った。

　死を受容し――
　そして彼女は拳を握る。

　最後まで戦うために。

　しかしその願いは、一度だけだが叶えられたのだ。

　何も為し得ない己に悶々として長い生涯を過ごすの
に比べ、短い闘争の末に果てるこの今は、間違いなく

　綾弥一条はそう思った。

　死を受容し――
　そして彼女は拳を握る。

　最後まで戦うために。
